summary: North East Medical Services detected unauthorized access to its data hosted on United Layer's network on October 19, 2025, and completed its investigation on December 17, 2025. An unknown threat actor accessed a limited amount of personally identifiable information, including names and other unspecified data elements, affecting an undisclosed number of individuals. NEMS engaged third-party forensic specialists to investigate and is offering complimentary credit monitoring services to affected individuals through Cyberscout (a TransUnion company).
